endpointAudit.reviewNote: The trail endpoints are mapped Lamoille access or water-entry anchors. Upper Lamoille Access and Oxbow Park are public trail/town sites; Cadyville, Waterman Brook, Dog Head Falls, Dorothy Smith, below-Fairfax Falls and Arrowhead Mountain Lake use mapped or Vermont agency/public-ramp anchors with explicit access/path verification caveats. The ten added combinations reuse these same documented water-entry anchors and preserve the marked falls/dam portage boundaries; the Upper-to-Fairfax combination is explicitly staged multi-day.
